name: Homebox
description: An inventory for the things in a home: items with photos, receipts, warranties and locations, labels, and export to a spreadsheet. One small Go binary with its own SQLite database.

access.note: Homebox starts with no accounts and registration open: the first visit shows a sign-in page with a Register link, and the account made there owns the inventory. Register yourself right after deploying, then set HBOX_OPTIONS_ALLOW_REGISTRATION to false from the Variables tab and redeploy, because until then anyone who reaches the address can make an account too.

inputs.name: domain
inputs.label: Public domain
inputs.description: Optional; the address other people open; nothing else here changes when it does.

inputs.name: registration
inputs.label: Allow registration
inputs.description: Whether the sign-in page offers a Register link. Leave it on for the first account, then turn it off.

secrets.name: api-key-pepper
secrets.label: API key pepper
secrets.description: Keys the hashes of the API keys Homebox issues; the image refuses to start without one, and rotating it invalidates every issued API key.

volumes.name: data
volumes.purpose: The SQLite database and uploaded photos and documents

update.notes: Homebox migrates its database on start and does not migrate back; it is still before 1.0, so read the release notes.
